# @amykit/plugin-notify-hermes

Announcements over Hermes, which already owns the messaging credentials.

A plugin for [amy](https://github.com/nicolasmelo1/amy). It provides `hermes` in the `notify-channel` collection.

## Install

```sh
npm install -g @amykit/plugin-notify-hermes
```

Then name it in `~/.amy/config.yaml`:

```yaml
workflows:
  your-profile:
    plugins:
      - "@amykit/plugin-notify-hermes"
```

## Configuration

```yaml
plugins:
  "@amykit/plugin-notify-hermes":
    target: <string>
```

| Setting | Type | Required | Default | What it is |
| :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `target` | `string` | **yes** |  | a Hermes delivery target, such as `slack:my-channel` or a bare platform name for its home channel |

Every field is checked at boot against the schema this package declares. A key that is
not one of the above is a refusal naming the plugin and the key, not a setting that
silently never applied.
